_meta.description: The rhythm of scoring windows. Dual-type events alternate every 2 weeks.

schedule.name: Kingdom of Power (KvK)
schedule.note: The main event. Next K1762 KvK ≈ Aug 11 prep. Hold your best materials for this.

schedule.name: Strongest Governor
schedule.note: Your mid-cycle individual push. 7 stages, each scoring different actions.

schedule.name: Alliance Brawl
schedule.note: Individual + alliance. Good easy-filler for construction/research/training.

schedule.name: Armament Competition T1
schedule.note: Hero Shard focus. LOW per-shard — only spend true overflow here.

schedule.name: Armament Competition T2
schedule.note: Truegold/Gear focus. LOW rates — Officer Project beats it for gear.

schedule.name: Officer Project T1
schedule.note: THE window for Mithril (60K), Widgets (12K), Forgehammers (6K).

schedule.name: Bear Trap
schedule.note: Solo PvE. Single-march burst damage — high-tier troops + best combat heroes.

schedule.name: Merchant Empire
schedule.note: Escort caravans for Brawl points. Target enemy SSR (yellow) carts.
